headline: Common Electrical Mistakes to Avoid During a Home Remodel
articleBody: When you're remodeling your home, especially in areas like the East Bay, it's easy to overlook some key electrical considerations that can lead to big headaches. One frequent mistake is underestimating the power load your new setup will need, which can lead to tripped breakers or worse. Another common error is placing outlets or switches in awkward or impractical locations; you want them where they're actually convenient! Skipping permit and inspection steps is a huge no-no, as it can cause problems with resale or even safety issues. And trust me, closing up walls before all the electrical work is thoroughly tested is just asking for trouble. Using an installer who isn't properly qualified can also result in code violations and costly rework down the line. For remodel electrical work, particularly in kitchens and bathrooms, ensuring proper planning for lighting, fans, and appliance circuits is critical. To avoid these pitfalls, always work with licensed and insured professionals who have experience with remodels and understand the local codes. Getting it right from the start ensures your new space is safe and functions perfectly.
